name: Camp Gash
source:
It's the late 1980s. You've been hired into a summer camp, located in the heart of Appalachia. The air is crisp, your coworkers are hot, and you are surrounded by friends! Lucky you!

However, something dark stalks the grounds of the camp. It fills you with fear... among other things. Decisions made on night one may, determine your fate.

Will you find love? Will you make enemies? Will you survive? 

Find out by playing Camp Gash!

[From [url=https://pillowprincessgames.itch.io/camp-gash]itch.io[/url]]
